question_text: A production studio has editors, productions and supervisors. Each editor belongs to exactly one production; each production has one or more editors. Each supervisor oversees one or more productions; each production has exactly one supervisor. Construct an ERD showing the two relationships and cardinalities.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: SUPERVISOR 1—many PRODUCTION; PRODUCTION 1—many EDITOR. Every production has one supervisor and every editor one production; minimum participation follows the stated one-or-more requirements.
